npcs.name: Guild Master
dialog: Welcome to the Adventurers Guild of Silverspire.
The Tower stands at the heart of our city, and none have reached its summit.
Take a contract from the board whenever you are ready.

npcs.name: Fisher
dialog: The river runs clear this season.
Cast from the end of the pier - the big ones sit deep.

npcs.name: Farmer
dialog: Good soil this side of the river.

npcs.name: Hunter
dialog: Keep to the path after dark.

npcs.name: Miner
dialog: Watch your step near the shaft.
